theme: Hybrid (Deep Ocean Dark & Warm Sand Light)

design_philosophy.core_feeling: Professional, clean, safe, exciting, and premium.
design_philosophy.visual_mood: Deep ocean blues transitioning into warm sandy beiges. Immersive underwater storytelling paired with high-end, editorial layout structures to build trust and drive high-ticket bookings.
anti_patterns: No bright cartoonish blues or pure black.
Avoid completely flat design; rely on subtle gradients, glassmorphism, and deep shadows.

primary.name: Deep Ocean
primary.description: Used for dark section backgrounds, primary text on light backgrounds.

secondary.name: Caribbean Turquoise
secondary.description: Used for accents, hover states, secondary buttons, and highlighting key text.

accent.name: WhatsApp Green
accent.description: Strictly used for WhatsApp booking CTA buttons to ensure high conversion.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight text-balance
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight text-balance

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing: py-20 to py-32 for sections to allow the design to breathe.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento grids for destinations and imagery. Asymmetrical layouts for editorial storytelling. Direct children of grid MUST be the motion.div or standard div.

surface_styles.solid_card: bg-white border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow duration-300

navigation.style: Sticky/Fixed header (z-50). Crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#061A2B]/80 border-b border-white/10).
navigation.elements: Brand Logo (left), Nav Links (center desktop), EN/ES Toggle & Primary WhatsApp CTA (right).

buttons.primary_whatsapp: bg-[#25D366] text-white hover:bg-[#20bd5a] font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-full flex items-center gap-2 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-lg shadow-[#25D366]/20
buttons.secondary_glass: bg-white/10 text-white backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/20 font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-full transition-colors
buttons.outline_dark: border-2 border-[#061A2B] text-[#061A2B] hover:bg-[#061A2B] hover:text-white font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-full transition-colors

cards.tour_card: Use solid_card on light backgrounds or dark_glass on deep backgrounds. Must contain: Image, Title, Price, Duration, small tags (e.g., 'Beginner Friendly'), and a full-width WhatsApp booking button.
cards.destination_card: Image background with dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent). Text placed at the bottom. Scale image on hover.

ui_components.floating_whatsapp: Fixed to bottom-right corner (z-50). Circular shape, big WhatsApp icon, shadow-2xl, pulse animation.

Home: Hero: Full-width underwater image, deep gradient overlay, H1 (Scuba Diving in Riviera Maya), Dual CTAs, Trust Badges (PADI, 5-Star).
About/Intro: Warm Sand background (light). Editorial layout with overlapping images (turtle/reef), introduction to the premium experience.
Featured Tours: Deep Ocean background. 3-4 glass cards highlighting top tours (Cenote, Cozumel, Reef).
Destinations: Bento grid (Tulum, Playa del Carmen, Cozumel).
Why Choose Us: Icon grid (Safety, Small Groups, Premium Equipment).
Testimonials: Sand background, elegant carousel/masonry of reviews.
Footer: Deep Ocean background, soft wave SVG divider at top.
pages_structure.Tours: Grid of all diving and snorkeling tours with filtering options (Reef, Cenote, Beginner).
pages_structure.Courses: PADI courses from Open Water to Divemaster. Emphasize safety and professional instruction.
pages_structure.Destinations: Detailed sections for each location, explaining what marine life to expect (Bull sharks, Whale sharks).
pages_structure.Reviews: Dedicated trust-building page with TripAdvisor/Google review embeds or styled cards.
pages_structure.FAQ: Accordion (Shadcn) layout answering common questions (water temp, gear, safety).
pages_structure.Contact: Booking form, location maps, direct WhatsApp/email links.

motion_and_interaction.scroll_reveal: Use framer-motion for fade-up on scroll (initial={opacity: 0, y: 20} whileInView={opacity: 1, y: 0}).
motion_and_interaction.hover_effects: Images scale up subtly (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden containers. Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-1).
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Smooth fade between routes (if using React Router).

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Playfair Display for headings and Outfit for body text (import via Google Fonts).
Ensure the EN/ES toggle is functional at least at the state level (updating content via a simple context or state hook).
Implement the soft wave shapes using SVG paths as section dividers (e.g., between the Dark Hero and the Light About section).
Do NOT use generic Shadcn cards for the premium glass aesthetic; construct them manually using pure HTML/Tailwind as specified in surface_styles.
The sticky WhatsApp button is critical for conversion. It must be visible on all pages on both mobile and desktop.
Strictly follow the color palette to maintain the 'premium ocean' feel.
